title: Canonical mission envelope materializer
goal: Materialize the admitted tablet candidate into the reserved next canonical primary ID under V2-008C policy without activation or execution.
laws: Revision mission V2-008C.R does not consume a primary sequence position.
The source candidate must exist durably and remain immutable.
A matching MISSION_ID_ALLOCATION_REQUEST must be durably ADMITTED by Trust Canal.
The target ID must come only from the proven V2-008C policy.
The canonical envelope must satisfy GPT_RAILS minimum fields with zero mutation authority.
Materialization must create a separate immutable candidate-to-mission binding rather than rewriting candidate evidence.
No active mission state, Talos, Hephaestus, Worker, model call, shell execution, or product mutation is started.
